about.title: About
about.visionText1: Lucions is a personal photography project — a curated collection of images captured over the years. From stark black & white compositions to vibrant, high-energy color work, this portfolio represents a continuous exploration of light, texture, and the fleeting moments that make the everyday extraordinary.
about.visionText2: Every photograph here is a reflection of curiosity — an attempt to find beauty in the mundane, tension in the quiet, and stories in the spaces between.
about.getInTouchText: Interested in prints, collaborations, or just want to say hello? Feel free to reach out.
